computeArchitecture.type: Split-Compute (Lightweight Glasses + Tethered Compute Puck via USB-C Cable)
computeArchitecture.glassesChip: XREAL X1S Spatial Coprocessor (handles low-latency display output, sensor fusion, hand tracking pipeline)
computeArchitecture.puckChip: Qualcomm Snapdragon Reality Elite Platform (runs Android XR OS, AI/ML inference, heavy rendering)
computeArchitecture.batteryCapacity: 4,455 mAh (34.84 Wh) — located in Compute Puck
computeArchitecture.tether: USB-C cable between glasses and puck

displayAndOptics.dimming: 5-Level Electrochromic Transparency Dimming (adjustable lens opacity for focus)

connectivity.puckUsb: USB-C with DisplayPort-In (allows tethering to PCs, laptops, handheld consoles like Steam Deck / ROG Ally)

sensorsAndTracking.privacyIndicator: Hardware active camera LED indicator (physical privacy signal)
sensorsAndTracking.primaryInput: Low-latency bare-hand gesture tracking (Hand Engine pipeline via X1S coprocessor)

softwareAndEcosystem.aiIntegration: Native Google Gemini multimodal spatial perception
softwareAndEcosystem.multitasking: Up to 5 spatial window panes simultaneously
compatibleHosts: Steam Deck / ROG Ally via USB-C DP

simulationProfile.note: Fastest execution device in the AuraBeat hardware matrix. Snapdragon Reality Elite + X1S dual-chip split-compute delivers the highest sustained XR throughput.
